content.title: No Joke: Dunkin’® is Giving Away One Million Free Coffees This April Fools' Day
content.text: On April 1, trust no one…except us. 😉 While everyone else is busy pulling pranks this April Fools' Day, we here at Dunkin’® are skipping the tricks and serving up something real: a free coffee to fuel you on the one day you might need it the most. On Tuesday, April 1, we’re giving away one million FREE Hot or Iced Coffees or Cold Brews of any size* to Dunkin’ Rewards members, while supplies last. All you need to do to enjoy a free coffee on us is enter the promo code ThisIsNotAJoke in the Dunkin’ app. Let’s be honest, if there was ever a day you deserve a treat, it’s today. Trust issues are everywhere on April Fools' Day, and we’re here to help you get through it, one sip at a time. Still feeling skeptical? We get it. Go ahead and enter the code. No tricks, just delicious coffee! Remember, stay strong out there, because April 2 is coming… Stay up-to-date on all things Dunkin’ by following us on social media (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube) and subscribe to the Dunkin’ blog to receive notifications at news.dunkindonuts.com/blog. *Promo Code valid on 4/1/25 only or until code limit is reached. Free Coffee and Cold Brew Reward is valid until 4/8. Single-use only. Reward must be used on coffee and cold brew beverages only. Espresso not included.
